programme.title: Cheat Meal
programme.desc: Tyler and Monica head to Galveston, Texas, to create a fiery feast for Concetta, the spice-obsessed owner of Maceo Spice & Import Co. From the coastal vibes at Vida Agave to island-famous eats at The Spot, savory classics at Mario’s Seawall, local favorites at Mosquito Cafe, and indulgent sweets from Pattycakes Bakery, they turn up the heat to craft a cheat meal packed with bold flavors and Galveston flair.

programme.title: Amplify: USVI
programme.sub-title: Amplify USVI: The Global Stage: St. Croix Blowing Up
programme.desc: Host Naydyeyah Acoy-Thomas traces the rich, layered history of St. Croix’s musical roots, uncovering the deep ties to African, European, and indigenous Taíno traditions. Featuring voices like Asta Williams, Willard John, Rashidi Clenance, and Vio International, the episode explores how genres such as quelbe, calypso, and scratch band music were born from the island’s complex past. Through storytelling, performances, and cultural insight, Naydyeyah reveals how the rhythms of resilience and celebration continue to echo through generations.

programme.title: Prueba de Fe

programme.title: Una Deliciosa Navidad
programme.desc: Máximo y Luciana son amantes de la cocina. Pero hasta allí llegan sus coincidencias. Él es un prestigioso chef apasionado por la comida molecular, y ella es una cocinera intuitiva empeñada en rescatar los sabores de su tierra. Cuando el destino los junta, en plena Navidad, en el restaurante que Máximo hereda de su padre y que Luciana regenta, la combinación es explosiva. Pero también deliciosa.

programme.title: Intercambio Navideno
programme.desc: MAYA y ANA MARÍA son gemelas. Pero fueron separadas al nacer y entregadas a diferentes familias. Fueron criadas de maneras opuestas. ANA MARÍA es ahora una exitosa empresaria divorciada, que solo piensa en su éxito y en el trabajo. MAYA una incansable filántropa, criada por una familia que se dedica a trabajar en pro de los más necesitados. Ya adultas se descubren una a la otra y deciden guardar el secreto, para no hacer daño a sus familias. Pero una navidad deciden hacer la travesura de intercambiar sus vidas por una noche. Sin sospechar que aquella decisión las cambiará para siempre.

programme.title: Una Navidad Para Recordar
programme.desc: Sebastián detesta la navidad. Y esta le será particularmente difícil, puesto que es la primera que pasa sin sus hijos, después de un duro divorcio. Decide alejarse de la ciudad y pasar la temporada en la casa en que nació, visitando a su madre Ángela, que padece alzheimer. En esa breve y nostálgica temporada, SEBASTIÁN reencuentra la fe en la vida, se reconcilia con la familia, consigue un nuevo camino para el amor y recupera la emoción de la Navidad.

programme.title: Una Navidad Complicada
programme.desc: En medio de la temporada navideña, Leticia y Guillermo, divorciados desde hace años, enfrentan una situación inesperada cuando su hijo adolescente recurre a una trampa para reunirlos, falsificando un correo electrónico conde invita a Guillermo y su nueva novia a la casa familiar para Navidad. A medida que la forzada convivencia avanza, la relación entre Guillermo y su exesposa va cambiando. Guillermo descubre cuanto extraña su antigua vida, su vida familiar estable y hermosa. Y descubre que sigue amando a Leticia. Pero, para regresar definitivamente, necesita ganarse el perdón de Leticia y demostrarle que está dispuesto a cambiar. No es tan fácil, pero tal vez el espíritu navideño ayude a que suceda el milagro.

programme.title: Maine Dil Tujhko Diya
programme.desc: College stud and a famed band player Ajay is introduced to the stunning daughter of a business tycoon named Ayesha. Ajay is smitten by Ayesha's modesty and coyness and what starts off as a mere acquaintance soon turns into full-blown love affair. But Ayesha's father Mr. Verma is unhappy with their union and his associate Mr. Chopra takes advantage of his discontentment. Mr. Chopra, wanting to take over Mr. Verma's fortune, suggests his own son for Ayesha and brainwashes him about Ajay. The situation takes a deadly turn when a hit-man is appointed to end Ajay's life. But seeing Ajay's aggressive stubbornness to be with Ayesha, Mr. Verma gives him a challenge, to find his lady-love within a day or leave from her life forever. Ajay accepts the challenge, unaware that a bigger conspiracy is at work to tear them apart once and for all.

programme.desc: Open a can of “whoop-ass” with the “Swinging Cheerleaders,” “Sex Kittens,” and ‘Switchblade Sisters”

programme.title: The Baron
programme.desc: A black actor’s dream of making a movie becomes a nightmare when he’s forced to borrow money from local gangsters. Calvin Lockhart headlined this 1977 blaxploitation classic on the heels of “Let’s Do It Again” and “Uptown Saturday Night.”

programme.title: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: Duck You Suckers! It's time for more Grindhouse trailer fun from TFH!

programme.title: Asphalt Outlaws
programme.desc: High-octane tales of rebels, renegades, and road warriors burning rubber on the big screen.

programme.title: CC & Company
programme.desc: Football legend Joe Namath steps off the field and in front of the camera for this 1970 action picture directed by television veteran Seymour Robbie. After crossing paths with a dangerous gang in the desert, biker C.C. Ryder (Namath) must rescue the lovely fashion journalist Ann (Ann-Margaret) from their clutches.

programme.title: Mean Machines
programme.desc: Stay off the streets when these Hollywood stars get behind the wheel.

programme.title: Decades of Horror: 1930s
programme.desc: These are the gothic monsters, mad doctors, and undead terrors that defined the horror genre’s earliest films.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A young man turns to a witch doctor to lure the woman he loves away from her fiancé, but instead turns her into a zombie slave.

programme.title: Decades of Horror: 1940s Vol. 1
programme.desc: Your favorite filmmakers explore the eerie classics that defined a decade of supernatural thrills and monster madness.

programme.title: Decades of Horror: 1940s Vol. 2
programme.desc: These 1940s horror films define the decade's fascination with the supernatural and monstrous.

programme.title: House on Haunted Hill
programme.desc: Vincent Price is throwing a party, and he’s invited five strangers with the promise of $10,000 each, if they can survive the night in the House on Haunted Hill. Director William Castle helmed this 1959 horror hit, which famously utilized the “Emergo” theatrical gimmick to spook moviegoers out of their seats.

programme.title: Decades of Horror: 1950s Vol. 1
programme.desc: Spine-tingling chills and creature-feature thrills straight from the golden age of drive-in cinema.

programme.title: Decades of Horror: 1950s Vol. 2
programme.desc: Return to the era of radioactive beasts, twisted experiments, and larger-than-life B-movie terrors.

programme.title: Decades of Horror: 1960s Vol. 1
programme.desc: From Hitchcock to Corman the 1960s delivered a new era of horror that still haunts the screen.

programme.title: Dementia 13
programme.desc: Shocked by the death of her spouse, a scheming widow hatches a bold plan to get her hands on the inheritance, unaware that she is targeted by an axe-wielding murderer who lurks in the family's estate. What mystery shrouds the noble house?

programme.title: Decades of Horror: 1960s Vol. 2
programme.desc: From gothic chills to sci-fi paranoia, these 1960s shockers pushed horror into strange new realms of dread and imagination.

programme.title: Carnival of Souls
programme.desc: A young woman tries to escape her traumatic past, only to find herself haunted by a ghoulish mystery man from an abandoned carnival pavilion.

programme.title: Decades of Horror: 1970s Vol. 1
programme.desc: Enter the realm of 1970s horror, featuring vampiric tales, psychological terror, and innovative creature features.

programme.title: Decades of Horror: 1970s Vol. 2
programme.desc: Explore the grittier side of 1970s horror with a collection of gruesome tales that push the boundaries of blood and mayhem.

programme.title: Decades of Horror: 1970s Vol. 3
programme.desc: Experience the unsettling horror of the 1970s, featuring a mix of psychological tension, supernatural dread, and iconic cult films.

programme.title: Horror Express
programme.desc: Passengers aboard a Trans-Siberian Express train must fight to stay alive after a prehistoric creature escapes captivity and begins a murder spree.

programme.title: Decades of Horror: 1970s Vol. 4
programme.desc: From supernatural chillers to psychological thrillers, few decades can match the 70s when it comes to horror.

programme.title: Decades of Horror: 1970s Vol. 5
programme.desc: These 70s horror hits blend iconic slashers, cult classics, and supernatural threats with an atmosphere of terror and paranoia.

programme.sub-title: Keeping Up With The Joneses Episode 1
programme.desc: Meet the Joneses: an ordinary family living extraordinary lives at a vast cattle property called Coolabah in the heart of the Top End.

programme.title: Keeping up with the Joneses
programme.sub-title: Keeping Up With The Joneses Episode 2
programme.desc: Trevor the Cook wants to make a comeback as a jockey and he’s hoping Milton will lend him a horse. The Wet is over and the land around Coolibah is a tinderbox, one spark and the whole country could go up in flames.

programme.title: Keeping up with the Joneses
programme.sub-title: Keeping Up With The Joneses Episode 3
programme.desc: It’s the first big muster for the season. Milton’s running three choppers in the air and an army of workers on the ground. Young Jeff wants to fly with the big boys. But he’s got to earn respect on the ground first.

programme.title: Keeping up with the Joneses
programme.sub-title: Keeping Up With The Joneses Episode 4
programme.desc: The first big muster is over, but someone didn’t make it back home. Milton sends out a search party to track down one of his most trusted workers. Raine takes Jeff on a shopping trip and on the way back…. she picks up a live crocodile.

programme.title: Keeping up with the Joneses
programme.sub-title: Keeping Up With The Joneses Episode 5
programme.desc: Milton has put a bounty on the biggest barramundi someone can catch at Coolibah. It’s an annual fishing competition.

programme.title: Keeping up with the Joneses
programme.sub-title: Keeping Up With The Joneses Episode 6
programme.desc: It’s race day: the showdown between Trevor the Cranky Cook and Milton’s sister Terry. The last time Trevor raced was in 1984, when his horse threw him in the final straight. Milton finds a massive python…that has swallowed a wallaby.

programme.title: Keeping up with the Joneses
programme.sub-title: Keeping Up With The Joneses Episode 7
programme.desc: Bushfires break out at Coolibah. It’s Milton’s worst fear. With the fire burning up paddocks of cattle feed, he’ll have to fight through the night to contain it.

programme.title: Keeping up with the Joneses
programme.sub-title: Keeping Up With The Joneses Episode 8
programme.desc: The Joneses leave the comfort of Coolibah to spend a few days at the 100th Anniversary Brunette Races & Camp Draft. Cristina’s been training on her prized horse for months. But how will she fare against the toughest cowboys in Australia?

programme.title: Keeping up with the Joneses
programme.sub-title: Keeping Up With The Joneses Episode 9
programme.desc: Milton faces his worst nightmare. News is radioed through that a chopper has crashed 50km from Coolibah. He heads up a search party to find the wreckage and, hopefully, survivors.

programme.title: Keeping up with the Joneses
programme.sub-title: Keeping Up With The Joneses Episode 10
programme.desc: Milton encounters a fiery act of nature. Raine gives Little Milton a lesson about the Indigenous people of the Territory. And Milton carries out the dying wish of his mate Buckley. It’s a wake, Northern Territory style.

programme.title: Keeping up with the Joneses
programme.sub-title: Keeping Up With The Joneses Episode 11
programme.desc: Little Milton goes to school. For a boy growing up as the only kid within Coo-ee, a day at school is a special event. Cristina’s not sure how her independent little cowboy will go.

programme.title: Keeping up with the Joneses
programme.sub-title: Keeping Up With The Joneses Episode 12
programme.desc: Cristina Jones is pregnant! The Outback is a long, long way from medical help, so Cristina takes Milton and Little Milton 3,000 kilometers to Brisbane for scan to be safe.

programme.title: Lee Chan's World Food Tour
programme.sub-title: Lee Chan's World Food Tour Season 1 Episode 1
programme.desc: Lee is celebrating the Vietnamese New Year as thousands of people line the streets to enjoy song, dance and street style food. Lee soon finds herself cooking up a feast for some hungry locals.

programme.title: Lee Chan's World Food Tour
programme.sub-title: Lee Chan's World Food Tour Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Travelling back in time, Lee begins her tour like most tourists do – at the Pyramids of Giza. With so much history dating back thousands of years, it’s not long before Lee cooks some of the oldest dishes in the world.

programme.title: Lee Chan's World Food Tour
programme.sub-title: Lee Chan's World Food Tour Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: In France Lyon, is Lee’s first stop. This stunning town offers cooking classes - from Escargot, to trout wrapped in pastry, where Lee soon finds out that cooking French food is much easier than learning the language.

programme.title: Lee Chan's World Food Tour
programme.sub-title: Lee Chan's World Food Tour Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: South Korea is a beautiful country, but in this episode, Lee settles in the capital city, Seoul. South Korean food has its own identity with particular focus on fermenting vegetables.

programme.title: Lee Chan's World Food Tour
programme.sub-title: Lee Chan's World Food Tour Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Lee discovers Germany, a nation known for its breathtaking countryside and hearty cuisine.

programme.title: Lee Chan's World Food Tour
programme.sub-title: Lee Chan's World Food Tour Season 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: From the Great Wall to the Forbidden City, Lee tours China like never before. The streets of Beijing serve up a mix of modern architecture and ancient traditions, but nothing is more popular in Chinese cuisine than dumplings!

programme.title: Lee Chan's World Food Tour
programme.sub-title: Lee Chan's World Food Tour Season 1 Episode 7
programme.desc: Lee is rail hopping, road tripping and tasting her way through Canada’s famous Rocky Mountains. This fun-filled episode has everything from national dishes, iconic drinks and famous sporting games.

programme.title: Lee Chan's World Food Tour
programme.sub-title: Lee Chan's World Food Tour Season 1 Episode 8
programme.desc: India, the land of spices, welcomes Lee with open arms. With so much colour and spice at the centre of Indian culture, Lee decides to adopt some Indian fashion tips and dress up for the occasion.

programme.title: Lee Chan's World Food Tour
programme.sub-title: Lee Chan's World Food Tour Season 1 Episode 9
programme.desc: Lee is in Malaysia and heads straight to the capital city Kuala Lumpur. First stop is the famous Pertonas Towers before heading down to street level to sample the weird and wonderful food on offer.

programme.title: Lee Chan's World Food Tour
programme.sub-title: Lee Chan's World Food Tour Season 1 Episode 10
programme.desc: Lee’s journey in the USA begins in San Francisco, but with all roads leading to iconic sights and destinations, Lee is eventually drawn down to America’s South – for some soul food inspiration!
